card.name: Hyphen then B in bind/bound words
card.fires_on: The letter B (often "-B") that starts a word after a hyphen or joined prefix, such as non-benzodiazepine, Protein-Bound, ATP-Binding and Full Body-Bind. The following text is usually bind, bound or a similar B word.

modes.label: Protein-bound / binding
modes.description: A B piece right after Protein or ATP, leading into bound or binding.
modes.example: 7.3 Highly Protein<<-B>>ound Drugs Dronabinol is highly

modes.label: non-benzodiazepine
modes.description: A b piece after "non" in the list of CNS depressants, leading into benzodiazepine.

modes.label: Other bind words
modes.description: A B piece at the start of bind-type words in other settings, such as a curse name or a brand name.
modes.example: Harry Potter tried to cast the charm nonverbally and wandlessly to retrieve his wand after Draco Malfoy hit him with a Full Body<<-B>>ind Curse in 1996

card.writes: It pushes the model toward bind, binding and bound as the next word piece.
card.plain: It fires on a lone B after a hyphen or prefix when a word like bound, binding or benzodiazepine is coming.
